balloons.text: Two mornings later. Ninth round complete.
Daro brought the packing stock up. His cart is below.
DaroI would rather earn something on the way back.
KivaThis set is Rusk’s. The buyer’s is still in the jig.
I thought I was taking it to Rusk.
KivaYou are collecting it for me. We have not agreed the rest yet.
Rusk asked for the rear yard today. His long frame is in the front aisle.
DaroYou bring the box to the landing. I take the cart leg; her board comes back with you.
DaroThe cart cannot climb these steps. From that landing, the ramp goes round to his yard.
Will you walk to the east washhouse with us after tomorrow’s round?
SeraYes. With the person handing the goods over.
